## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and linked to an issue or design discussion when
      appropriate.
- [ ] Tests cover positive, negative, and adversarial behavior where relevant.
- [ ] Documentation, schemas, models, manifests, and release notes are updated
      where their contract changes.
- [ ] No credential, key, token, customer data, private endpoint, or confidential
      material is included.
- [ ] I reviewed all AI-assisted output and accept responsibility for its
      correctness, security, licensing, and originality.
- [ ] Every commit includes a valid `Signed-off-by` trailer.
- [ ] I did not weaken a security check to make a test or demonstration pass.
